packet.title: More source code languages, a registration API, run-time languages (design and implementation)

item.p: Owner (2026-10-20, answering 's proposal): TypeScript, TSX and Markdown built in; a public API to register tree-sitter languages; new languages at run time from tree-sitter language files, loaded by the host. Order: the book, the tests, the implementation.

Owns: 7.22's files, src/source_code_check.c, apps/sxml/code_languages.c/.h, apps/sxml/platform_library_loader.c, the library loader of apps/cli_framework, the source code part of include/sxml/processor.h.

Done when: the chapter's examples match; the new grammars' tests run with a baseline; a test loads a language from a library it builds; the sizes reported and the budgets raised. Done 2026-10-20 (): the chapter (32 examples match); eleven languages; locals and injections; the registration API and --code-language; tree-sitter/suite 1,410 of 1,438 (highlights 187 of 187); sxml.wasm 13,425,285 bytes, budgets 14,000,000 and the CLI 15,500,000 / 2,900,000. Delayed: .wasm language files in the JavaScript package, the native wasm store, the host shim.
